step_2_comment_quality_audit.manual_review_note: The complete-code section and reference were read from start to finish. Comments retain record/global indices, actual T=1 branch versus T=50 fusion axes, memmap copy and dtype boundaries, input tuple ordering, Windows close behavior, and local torch.Generator semantics; workflow inventories, optional hardening lists, empty-record rejection, and duplicate cache-shape checks were removed.

step_3_comment_quality_audit.manual_review_note: The complete-code section, reference, and formal exercise annotations were read from start to finish under the 2026-07-22 causal-comment standard. Every step-3 function now identifies each parameter's upstream creator and the return value's downstream consumer. Intermediate accumulators, counters, cursor, paths, learning-rate snapshots, best/last state, device movement, raw/wave/label indexing, and memmap lifetime explain both what they hold and why the algorithm needs them. The run_epoch worked example explicitly maps weighted_loss to the numerator and position_count to the denominator. No duplicate production-hardening checks were added.

step_4_comment_quality_audit.manual_review_note: The step-4 complete-code section and independent reference were read from imports through the final result. Each parameter names its upstream creator and downstream consumer. Comments explain why three RNGs are seeded, why timers and loss histories need independent variables, why CUDA peak stats are reset, why test data is opened only after validation selection, why best and last have different roles, and why paths, NumPy counts, runtime, and memory are converted before JSON output. The main path adds only the correctness-critical positive-step check; CLI, schema, cache hashes, worker hardening, and auto-recovery are excluded from the core lesson.

remaining_stage_performance_audit.conclusion: No training path repeated the cache builder's serial per-epoch CWT bottleneck. Raw loading remains an optional optimization candidate; wave and especially fusion were compute-dominated. The later formal 20/20/50 run completed and passed milestone acceptance.

experiment_semantics: The teaching reconstruction completed the full four-split cache, all real-data preflights, fixed-seed 20/20/50 training, validation-only checkpoint selection, and one formal test. The resulting metrics are a single-dataset, single-seed engineering result and do not establish paper ten-fold or multi-seed performance.
acceptance_policy: Step tests are development self-checks. Milestone 9B was marked completed only after its full experiment, one-time test, artifacts, regressions, interface synchronization, comment gate, and claim boundary passed one whole-milestone review.
